name: grouper-embedding-calibration
description: Reproducible calibration of EmbeddingGemma v1 vs v2 (ONNX, transformers.js) for free-form Danish/English interest tags: merge thresholds, sensitive-interest detector, online clustering, latency.

scripts.download: bash scripts/download-model.sh onnx-community/embeddinggemma-300m-ONNX 5090578d9565bb06545b4552f76e6bc2c93e4a66 q4 q8 fp32 && bash scripts/download-model.sh onnx-community/embeddinggemma-2-ONNX daa72c51243991dfcaf9f9137d2c573d8f7790c0 q4 q8 fp32
scripts.analyze: for r in v1:q4 v1:q8 v1:fp32 v2:q4 v2:q8 v2:fp32; do node scripts/analyze.mjs $r --ref ${r%%:*}:fp32; done
scripts.compare: node scripts/compare.mjs v1:q4 v2:q4,v2:q8,v2:fp32 --boot 500 && node scripts/compare.mjs v2:q4 v2:q8 --boot 500 --out comparison_v2q4_vs_v2q8
